decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel sits close to the firm's core cheese offer and got its own page in 2019, so it is a visible commitment that would be costly to abandon, and weak sales can still be read as temporary.

The spicy cheese was promoted on its own page and belongs to the 2018 cheese range the firm presented publicly, so management is inclined to persist even though flavored variants like Product B were already cut.
The mild creamy soft cheese was publicly announced as rounding off the new range and then given its own page, so dropping it would expose that launch decision as a mistake, which favors keeping it.
